title: StatementRow
description: One row of the CSV served by GET /providers/{provider}/statements, as a document: the column order of the file is `propertyOrder` below. The hub reads the file, not this schema; it exists so a row's shape is stated once, and so an injected mismatch can be described as a deviation from a row that validates.

external_reference.description: The top-up uuid the collection named. A formula-injection test row puts a =HYPERLINK( formula here.

fee_minor.description: Always 0 in v1: the contract's envelopes carry no fee line (slice 04 open item).

status.description: A same-day statement lists what settled; a failed or reversed collection is a reconciliation difference, not a line.

payer_msisdn_last4.description: Last four digits only: a statement is a file that gets mailed around.
